summary: Hard dependencies Tracks 02 and 03 have archived completion receipts and the repository baseline passes 184 tests plus governance validation. Track 04 remains a later-phase dependency only; its pending NSW owner decision limits affected jurisdiction-specific cases and claims without blocking synthetic governance, contracts, deterministic baselines, or national and Queensland scenarios.

Implemented benchmark governance schema and registry, six synthetic challenge cases across text, document, audio, image and signal descriptors, five hard safety/privacy gates, deterministic network-disabled suites, hashed receipts, device proxies, compact reports, CI automation and explicit H0-H8 legacy mappings. Review fixes b954a33 and 03bd75e added exact cross-platform execution manifests, emitted citation and robustness measures, completed device observations, and rejected malformed fixtures. The regression baseline passed 5 of 5 structural cases; 190 repository tests passed at 84.79 percent coverage plus lint, types, gremlin and governance checks. Generative comparators, human agreement and operational threshold calibration remain blocked on decision 20260829-002-track05-comparator-staging; no model or publication claim is made.

Fresh review closed false-completion risks in fixture traversal and symlink escape, duplicate or malformed cases, unverified modality claims, partial hard-gate enforcement, unchecked report receipts, and the missing distracting/alternative/unknown case evidence. The regenerated deterministic regression passed 6 of 6 runnable cases; the pending NSW case remains excluded. Validation passed 194 tests at 84 percent coverage plus benchmark schema, Ruff, ty, basedpyright, gremlin and repository-governance checks. Track completion and archival remain prohibited while owner decision 20260829-002-track05-comparator-staging is pending.
